title: Enterprise security needs mosaic and response scheduler
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Problem: Customer security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA + lengthy vendor questionnaires) currently land in a mix of channels (support, sales, CSMs) and are routed manually. This causes duplicated evidence work, inconsistent SLAs, and long response cycles for enterprise prospects.

Goal: Build a deterministic, auditable classification and scheduling system that: 1) produces a compact 'security needs mosaic' score for each request (regulatory footprint, contract exposure, data residency, technical surface area, and customer tier); 2) automatically assigns a response lane, prioritized SLA, and owner; 3) surfaces required evidence and template bundles to minimize back-and-forth.

Scope: Non-bug product work across product, support, solutions, and security: classification schema, priority rules, soft-SLA scheduler, evidence bundle templates, and a simple dashboard to track aging requests and outcomes. This ticket covers PM ownership, design alignment, and the first automation prototype (no infra / Dedicated runtime changes).
acceptance_criteria: Define 'mosaic' scoring rubric with <=8 contributing signals and threshold buckets (low/medium/high/critical)
Create a mapping from mosaic buckets to response lanes, SLA hours, and ownership (CSM/support/security-expert)
Prototype a scheduler that picks next-available owner and commits a due_date automatically for 80% of incoming sample requests
Publish evidence-bundle templates for SOC2, GDPR/DPA, and HIPAA questions and link them to the scheduler outputs
Dashboard widget showing throughput, average time-to-first-response, and percent automated routing
Security review completed for evidence templates and any automated disclosure text
steps: Run historical sample of 400 past enterprise security requests and label by outcome (auto-resolved / manual) — Analytics (growth) to provide dataset
Workshop with security and legal to finalize scoring signals and edge-case handling (PII, regulated-data), capture notes in Confluence
Implement initial rule-based classifier in a serverless prototype (PM + eng proto) and validate against sample set
Design evidence-bundles (templates + links) with Design/Docs and validate with two pilot customers
Add scheduler rules (owner selection, work-stealing, escalation) and expose simple API for support/CSM systems
Ship dashboard and run 2-week pilot, measure automation rate and SLA attainment

notes: Trade-offs discussed: full ML classifier would reduce manual rules but requires labeled data and explainability work for enterprise audits.
Risk: automated evidence packaging must not leak customer-specific contractual language — templates must be sanitized and approved by Legal.
Mitigation: all auto-responses carry an explicit 'subject to review' tag for customers in 'medium' mosaic bucket until a security approval workflow is reached.
Follow-ups: schedule a 60-minute cross-functional demo with Support, Solutions, Security, and Legal in Cycle 2026-W12 to align owner roles and escalation paths.
